title: The Quran: Surah 97, al-Qadr (Decree)
author: Tradução inglesa de Talal Itani (ClearQuran)
tradition: Texto sagrado do Islão, século VII
intro: Lição sobre a Surata 97. O texto inglês é a tradução de Talal Itani, reproduzida sem alterações; as notas de língua, perguntas, discussão e escrita são material pedagógico separado, baseado apenas no que o próprio texto diz.

source.title: Quran English Translation: Clear, Pure, Easy to Read Modern English
source.edition: Edition A (uses the word 'Allah' to refer to the Creator)

questions.q: According to verse 3, the Night of Decree is better than:
questions.why: O versículo 3 diz: 'better than a thousand months'.

questions.q: What kind of comparison is verse 3?
options: One that says a single night is worth more than a very long time
One that says the night is short
One that says the night is dark
One that says the night is far away
questions.why: Compara uma noite com mil meses.

options: Verse 2 asks a question and verse 3 gives a statement about the night
questions.why: O versículo 2 faz a pergunta e o versículo 3 diz algo sobre a noite.

questions.q: Which sentence best sums up the passage?
options: It describes one special night and what happens in it until dawn
It tells about a long trip
questions.why: Os versículos 1 a 5 falam da Noite do Decreto, do que desce nela e até quando dura.

B2.discussion: The passage compares one night to a thousand months. Why do people compare small units of time with large ones to show value?
B2.writing: Write 80 to 100 words: Describe what the passage says about the Night of Decree.

questions.q: What descends in the night, according to verse 4?
questions.why: O versículo 4 diz: 'In it descend the angels and the Spirit'.

questions.q: 'By the leave of their Lord' means:
'Until the rise of dawn' (verse 5) shows that:
options: the night described has an end point
questions.why: 'Until the rise of dawn' marca o fim da noite descrita.

questions.q: How many times does 'Night of Decree' appear in the passage?

options: The passage presents one night as better than a long span of time, and describes what takes place until dawn
The passage has no clear topic
questions.why: O versículo 3 compara e os versículos 4 e 5 descrevem.

C1.discussion: 'Night of Decree' is repeated three times in three verses. What does the repetition do?
C1.writing: Write 120 to 150 words: Explain how the question in verse 2 prepares the statement in verse 3.

questions.q: What does verse 5 say the night is?
'Peace it is' reverses ordinary word order. What effect does it have?
options: It puts 'Peace' first and gives a solemn tone
It makes the verse a question
It makes the verse a command
questions.why: A ordem invertida põe 'Peace' à frente e dá um tom solene.

questions.q: Verse 2 asks and verse 3 answers by comparison rather than by definition. What does this suggest?
options: That the night is explained by measuring its value, not by describing it
That the night is a month
questions.why: A resposta é uma comparação com mil meses.

questions.q: Which description of the sequence is most accurate?
questions.why: Cada versículo tem uma função distinta.

questions.q: 'Peace it is; until the rise of dawn' ends the passage. What does the ending do?
options: It closes with calm and a point in time
questions.why: 'Peace' e 'until the rise of dawn' fecham o texto com calma e um limite no tempo.

C2.discussion: The passage moves from an event to a question, a comparison, a description and a closing image. What does this order do for the reader?
C2.writing: Write 150 to 200 words: Analyse how the five verses are built, referring to specific words.
